title: Samach Vav Part 256:
blurb: Samach Vav p. 207: There are two levels -- a son and a servant. At times souls are called sons, and at times servants. Specifically, there are two types of souls: 1. Servant -- soul from nara"n of biy"a, who has a rational understanding of G-d ("knows G-d in a general way"). 2. Son -- who has merited naranc"h of atzilus, like a son who has intimate access to the “innermost chambers and secrets of his fathers’ home” ("knows G-d in a specific way," students of Kabbalah). Both these levels of souls (son and servant) are produced through the union of z"a and malchus of atzilus. (Zu"n of beriya creates angels, but not souls. Souls of atzilus mamash are born through the union of abba and ima).

title: After Selling Out 80,000 Copies, ‘Tanya Hasholeim’ Goes Online
blurb: Marking 230 years since the printing of the Tanya, and in honor of Yud-Tes Kislev, the publishing house makes the full text of 'Tanya Hasholeim' accessible to the public at no cost.
